title: Class VII CBSE Mathematics Syllabus 2026–2027
subject: Mathematics

learningOutcomes.statement: Applies sign rules for multiplication of negative and positive integers.
Demonstrates distributive property of multiplication over addition for integers.
Calculates reciprocal of proper and improper fractions and divides fractions.
Solves real-world word problems involving fraction multiplication.
Determines additive and multiplicative inverses of rational numbers.
Solves linear combinations of signed rational numbers with unlike denominators.
